# Ezekiel 43 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 43:4 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-the-glory-of YHWH came into the-house by-way-of the-gate which faces eastward. |
| LOGOS | And the glory of the LORD entered the temple by the gate facing east. |
| PNEUMA | The glory of the LORD entered the Temple through the east gateway. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

## 43:7 (overlap: 12%)

| Translator | Rendering |

| EMET | And-He-said to-me, "Son-of-man, [this-is] the-place-of My-throne and-the-place-of the-soles-of My-feet, where I-will-dwell in-the-midst-of the-sons-of Israel forever." |
| LOGOS | And He said to me, "Son of man, this is the place of My throne and the place of the soles of My feet, where I will dwell in the midst of the people of Israel forever." |
| PNEUMA | He said to me, "Son of man, this is the place of my throne and the place where I will rest my feet. I will live here among the people of Israel forever." |

| LOGOS | And behold, the glory of the God of Israel was coming from the east. And the sound of His coming was like the sound of many waters, and the earth shone with His glory. |
